name: code_chorus
definition_fr: Codes Chorus REFX d'identification des bâtiments et terrains: concaténation code région/code site/code bâtiment ou terrain
description_en: Chorus REFX code identifying the building or plot: region code, site code and building or plot code concatenated

name: id
description_en: Unique identifier of the asset

name: designation_site
description_en: Label of the site the asset belongs to

name: designation_batiment_terrain
description_en: Label of the building or plot

name: type
description_en: Predominant use of the asset

name: fonction
description_en: Detailed predominant use of the asset

name: adresse
definition_fr: Adresse normalisée du bien (n° et rue)
description_en: Normalised street address of the asset (number and street)

name: ville
description_en: Town where the asset is located

name: dept
definition_fr: Code du département de situation du bien
description_en: Code of the department where the asset is located

name: code_postal
definition_fr: Code postal de situation du bien
description_en: Postal code where the asset is located

name: code_insee
definition_fr: Code INSEE de situation du bien
description_en: INSEE code of the municipality where the asset is located

name: libelle_nouvelle_region
description_en: Name of the region

name: pays
description_en: Country where the asset is located

name: latitude
description_en: Latitude of the asset

name: longitude
description_en: Longitude of the asset

name: ministere
description_en: Ministry occupying the asset

name: libelle_gestionnaire
description_en: Label of the occupant

name: type_gestionnaire
description_en: Type of occupant

name: libelle_proprietaire
description_en: Label of the owner. Owners who are natural persons are published under a generic label, not by name

name: type_proprietaire
description_en: Type of owner

name: surface_m2
description_en: Floor area of the asset, in square metres

name: consommation_kwh_ef
definition_fr: Consommation énergétique du bien (kWh d'énergie finale)
description_en: Energy consumption of the asset, in kWh of final energy

name: type_de_chauffage
description_en: Heating type of the asset

name: etat_de_sante
definition_fr: Etat de santé générale du bien
description_en: General condition of the asset

name: annee_de_construction
description_en: Year the asset was built

name: tri_des_dechets
definition_fr: Identification des biens impliqués dans le tri des déchets
description_en: Whether the asset takes part in waste sorting

name: erp
definition_fr: Identification des établissements recevant du publique
description_en: Whether the asset is a venue open to the public (ERP)

name: date_de_reference
description_en: Reference date as published by the provider. Absent from the data dictionary, and carrying the same date across vintages: use millesime to date a row

name: millesime
description_en: Vintage the row belongs to, derived from the dataset identifier by the loader. This is the column to date a row by

name: _source_file
description_en: Name of the snapshot file the row was loaded from

name: _source_sha256
description_en: SHA-256 of the snapshot file the row was loaded from, matching its sidecar in data/snapshots/

name: _loaded_at
description_en: Timestamp of the load that inserted the row
